lines: Core CPI rose 0.3% in August versus 0.2% expected, beating forecasts and raising odds of a Fed rate hike at the upcoming meeting. [ef341c9193][752862c1a6][2bfb377124]
August CPI came in at 0.4% month-over-month as expected, with the annual pace holding at 3.4%, keeping pressure on the Fed to act on inflation warnings. [752862c1a6][6ffd3c64d6][2bfb377124]

The hotter-than-expected core inflation print puts Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's credibility on the line ahead of the rate decision, forcing a choice between hiking or risking doubts about his inflation commitment. [6ffd3c64d6]
Stock futures rose ahead of the CPI release after a 4-day market slide, with Oracle jumping and oil prices retreating providing some relief. [580a8c0144][c2ac29587f][fad807b6fa]
The Dow rallied following the inflation data release, with Nvidia rebounding alongside Oracle's jump. [8bb8bdda6c]
